blind.B1: Yes, an exercise question: voluntary wheel running (9 wk) in male mice on normal (NPD) or high phosphate diet (HPD), gastrocnemius-plantaris muscle RNA-seq (S2.3.p1, S2.8.p1, S3.7.p1). Exercise-carrying samples: NPE n=5 and HPE n=4 (GSE325957). Sedentary NPS/HPS n=3 each are taken from the earlier series GSE120958 (S2.8.p1, S9.p1), not sequenced in this study.
blind.B2: NPS vs NPE (9467 DEGs), HPS vs HPE (8009), NPS vs HPS, NPE vs HPE (10 DEGs) (S3.7.p1, S3.7.p2). n = 3-5 per group (FIG6 legend).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one GP muscle per mouse; no tissue, limb or time-point repeats in the RNA-seq. Candidate pairing keys in packet A: none. sample_group is a group label, not an animal key.
blind.B4: The paper says DESeq2 was run 'on sequencing from NPE and HPE samples and GSE120958' with Wald test and BH FDR (S2.8.p1); it does not say whether one joint model or pairwise fits were used. Four pairwise comparisons are reported.
blind.B5: Wald test, Benjamini-Hochberg padj < 0.05 (S2.8.p1; FIG8 legend); |log2FC| > 1.5 for heatmaps and > 0.5 for Enrichr input are stated in S2.8.p1; table headers (Tables S2/S3/S8) carry the DEG rule. Counts: NPS vs NPE 9467 (4540 up/4927 down), HPS vs HPE 8009 (3883 up/4126 down), NPE vs HPE 10 (S3.7.p1, S3.7.p2).

checks.evidence: Exercise arm exists (NPE/HPE); case was refused for a stated aliasing reason, not for lack of exercise arm. Decisions treat it as an exercise study.

NP S=3/E=5, HP S=3/E=4 match S2.8.p1 and FIG6 n=3-5; sedentary-from-GSE120958 mapping via the series' reanalysis sample list; no exclusions. Each exercise arm is contrasted with its own diet's sedentary control.
Contrasts are E (treatment) vs S (control) in both diet strata; no analysis was run.
One muscle per mouse (B3); packet A lists no pairing keys. The unused_subject_like_column flag is on sample_group, which is the group label (4 levels), not an animal ID: false positive.
Paper silent on joint vs pairwise (B4); no model fitted because the case stopped.

Activity is fully aliased with series (E: 9 in GSE325957, S: 6 in GSE120958); the paper itself says the sedentary samples are from GSE120958 (S2.8.p1, S9.p1). Recorded in covariance and discrepancies.

Only CPM deposited (integer fraction 0.58, non-integer positives); paper used featureCounts counts into DESeq2. Recorded as blocks_paper_method; limma on log2(CPM+1) correctly named as the only route.

Recorded padj < 0.05, |log2FC| > 0.5 from Tables S2/S3/S8 headers (non-inclusive). S2.8.p1 also names |log2FC| > 1.5 for heatmaps; the recorded rule matches the table headers. Reconstruction lists HPD as 2.0% Pi whereas FigS1 legend says 1.2% Pi (cosmetic, does not affect the stop).
HANDBACK reports paper counts only and states ours were not run; no claim beyond the numbers.

The claim is a positive one that can be checked: series crosstab shows E 0/9 and S 6/0 across GSE120958/GSE325957, and the paper confirms the source of the sedentary arm. The check was wide enough (both strata, crosstab, paper text). Not a 'data lack X' claim from a narrow search.

human_items: Open policy question: whether to still run the paper's own (batch-aliased) comparison as a labelled paper-reproduction with no biological claim, since the paper itself did exactly this; the skill's gate stops it.
Not an error: the CPM-only deposit would need limma on log2(CPM+1) even if the covariance gate were waived.
summary: 该案例在协方差关口被拒绝,理由成立:运动组(GSE325957)与久坐对照(GSE120958)完全对应不同系列,论文 S2.8.p1/S9.p1 也证实对照来自旧研究,运动效应无法与批次分开。分组、对比方向、阈值记录均与论文一致,sample_group 标记为受试者列是误报(它只是分组标签)。仅有的小问题是饮食磷含量记录为 2.0% 而图 S1 写 1.2%,不影响结论。
